traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Myrothamnaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins dentate; veins palmate; blades oblong or obovate; stipules present; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in spikes or in catkins; flowers actinomorphic; perianth absent; fruit follicle; stamens 3 to 8; carpels 3 to 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
